title: World's best Sourdough Stollen (traditional recipe)
ldKeywords: sourdough stollen, german stollen, christmas stollen
ldInstructionsRaw: Make a stiff sourdough starter that will help to have a more yeasty flavour
Mix together rum and the fruits
Knead the dough with all ingredients except the rum mixture
After building dough strength we mix together all the ingredients and knead some more
Ferment until dough roughly increased by 50% in size
Divide the Stollen and shape them.
Let your Stollen rest and preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Spritz your Stollen with water and let it bake with a tray on top of it for around 30 minutes
After 30 minutes wrap your Stollen with some aluminum foil
Melt some butter and brush your Stollen every with butter
After 120 minutes cover your Stollen everywhere with powdered sugar
Wrap your Stollen in Alu foil and then in a closed plastic bag. Let it mature for at least 1 day. Store it \ in a colder place in your house. It will stay good for a long time.
